§4.1 header, §4.2 page checksum, §4.3 system page, §4.4 page map, §4.5 section map, §4.6 masked page headers, §4.7 compression. §4.1's printed magic sequence (92 of the 0x6C bytes it names) and the four §4.7 worked examples run in examples/spec_examples.rs, through both LZ77 decoders (#107).

§5.1 to §5.4, §5.10 and §5.13 read on all three corpus files (#110). Password-protected files are refused. §5.5 Security and §5.6 AuxHeader are listed, not decoded. The streaming walk (src/streaming/r2007*.rs, #205) also verifies §5.12's CRCs, §5.4.1's checksum and every §5.13 codeword's syndromes, and reads §5.11's ten data bits for the CRC seeds, before it hands out a byte (§7aj); the legacy reader checks none of them, and §5.11's random encoder is needed only to write. §5.10.1's copy table is reproduced row for row by r21_lz (#107). src/reed_solomon.rs implements both §5.13 codes; every codeword of the eight pinned R2007 drawings verifies, re-encodes to AutoCAD's parity and is restored after injected errors (examples/probe_r2007_rs.rs, #275).
